description: Recursive(f) is answered by the engine: DeriveRecursive(f) waits on its static callees' Recursive, and f is recursive when its group has more than one member or a self-wait. Deletes ReachKey::Static, its product arm, ProductAddress::program if left unused, and Static reach telemetry. Proven (develop f822f0f84): the Static reach set's only production reader is derive_recursive (jobs/keying.rs ~263-272), which reads only reach.contains(Static(f)); the bit is load-bearing (key collapse, world.rs ~961, ~2521). Probe first: Recursive identical on the corpus. Note fz-229: StaticCallees omits closure/dispatch/function-ref edges; Recursive today is defined over StaticCallees and this ticket keeps that definition. Spike reference: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/dist/reachfact/.
title: A function is recursive exactly when its derivation's cycle group is cyclic
